title: Architecture: Modules & Vertical Slices
intro: Applies to: overall code organization, new features, module layout, slice shape, folder structure, placement of capabilities.

Lane boundaries: this family audits the slice as a unit (completeness, co-location, placement, naming). Route naming/middleware/status rules are owned by `http-api.md`; class-shape and single-action rules by `orchestration-di.md`; isolation import/FK rules by `isolation.md`. Note a missing piece once here; do not re-derive those families' per-line findings.

entries.rule: Domain code **MUST** be organized into modules, one namespace per business capability (`App\Subscriptions`, `App\Orders`, `App\Billing`), not into framework-type folders (`app/Services`, `app/Repositories`, `app/Actions` as a global dumping ground).

checks.coverage: Fails on any class in the `App\Services`, `App\Repositories` or `App\Actions` namespace. Does not judge whether a module namespace names a business capability.

entries.rule: A module **MUST** be named after the business capability in the domain's own language, not after a technical role.

Read-only contexts (reporting projections, CMS query layers, analytics) **MUST NOT** contain write commands or emit domain events. State changes belong to the owning context; a reporting context reacts to its events and answers queries.

checks.coverage: Fails on a `*Command` or `*CommandHandler` class in a namespace the project lists as read-only. Needs that list, and does not catch event dispatch.

entries.rule: A project **SHOULD** keep a domain glossary (ubiquitous language table) in its docs; a slice that introduces a new context **SHOULD** add its key terms there.
Every capability **MUST** ship as a vertical slice: one action folder holding all of its pieces.
items: Write slice: `{Action}Command`, `{Action}CommandHandler`, `{Action}Controller`, `{Action}Request`, `{Action}Resource` (when a body is returned), a named route, tests, and a past-tense domain event when state changes.
Read slice: `{Action}Query` (when parameterized), `{Action}QueryHandler`, `{Action}Controller`, `{Action}Resource`, a named route, tests. A fixed-criteria listing **MAY** omit the query object.
entries.lane_note: Route naming/middleware/status rules are owned by `http-api.md`; class-shape and single-action rules by `orchestration-di.md`.

entries.rule: Slice pieces **MUST** be co-located in that one folder. Code **MUST NOT** be scattered across type-named folders (`Controllers/`, `Requests/`, `Resources/`, `Enums/`, `Events/`, `Listeners/` inside a module).

checks.coverage: Fails on a class in a `Controllers`, `Requests`, `Resources`, `Enums`, `Events` or `Listeners` namespace segment inside a module.

entries.rule: Entity concept folders: a model **MUST** live in a folder with its factory, its enums, and its exceptions (`Subscription/` holds `Subscription.php`, `SubscriptionFactory.php`, `SubscriptionStatus.php`, `SubscriptionAlreadyCancelledException.php`).
The namespace **MUST** mirror the directory path exactly.
Every command/query **MUST** be wired to its handler explicitly (`Bus::map([...])` in the module's service provider), never by convention-based discovery.

A module **SHOULD NOT** introduce domain-concern grouping (`Lifecycle/`, `Queries/`) until it exceeds roughly ten action folders; premature grouping is a deviation. A grouped action folder **MUST** still contain its full slice.

A slice **MUST** live in the context that owns the capability. If a slice needs to import or instantiate another module's classes to do its job, it is in the wrong place or the collaboration **MUST** become a contract or event (see `isolation.md`).
entries.lane_note: Isolation import/FK rules are owned by `isolation.md`.

entries.rule: A write command **MUST NOT** be added to a read-only or reporting context.

checks.coverage: Fails on a `*Command` or `*CommandHandler` class in a namespace the project lists as read-only or reporting. Needs that list.

entries.rule: Classes, methods, commands, events, routes, and abilities **MUST** be named after the business language of their context.
entries.lane_note: Route naming/middleware/status rules are owned by `http-api.md`.

entries.rule: Technical/ETL/CRUD jargon **MUST NOT** be used where a domain term exists: `Manager`, `Processor`, `Helper`, `Util`, `Registry`, `Resolver`, `Transformer`, `Ingest`, `Upsert`, `Outcome`, generic `Service`.

checks.coverage: Fails on a class name ending in one of the listed terms. Does not cover method or route names, or whether a domain term exists.

entries.note: Suffixes are added only where the role would otherwise be ambiguous. With suffix: `{Action}Command`, `{Action}CommandHandler`, `{Action}Query`, `{Action}QueryHandler`, `{Action}Controller`, `{Action}Request`, `{Action}Resource`, `*Exception`, `*Listener`, `*Job`, `*Mail`. Without suffix: events (past-tense facts), models (nouns), enums (descriptive).

entries.rule: Methods and parameters **MUST** be named after the value actually passed, not aspirational domain language the value is not (`forUser(int $userId)`, not `forMember(int $userId)` when the argument is a plain user id).
